correctness.rationale: PASS: In source progressive-censored log likelihood each alpha enters as sum log[alpha(t+1)+1] plus linear terms, hence second derivative equals minus sum[((t+1)/(alpha(t+1)+1))²]. Observed Fisher information I=-H has positive diagonal and zero mixed terms; source prints those negative Hessian entries as I. Its printed matrix is -D for D positive definite, so the delta-method variance v^T(-D)^(-1)v<0 for any nonzero reliability gradient, and literal normal/logit Wald standard errors are nonreal. Positive measurements and alpha>0 handle boundaries; alpha outside source not asserted. Independently inspected source likelihood/CI formulas and derivative and gradient script; finite stress-strength example is diagnostic only.
